description: Compose a transaction to issue (create) a new Counterparty asset, or update an existing one.

address.description: Source Bitcoin address (will be the issuer)

asset.description: Asset name to create (4-12 uppercase chars, cannot start with A; or A + numeric ID for free numeric assets)

divisible.description: Whether the asset is divisible (8 decimal places)

inputs_set.description: Comma-separated UTXOs to use as inputs (txid:vout)

mime_type.description: MIME type for inscription (e.g. image/png, text/plain)

quantity.description: Raw integer amount to issue. For divisible: human amount * 10^8. For indivisible: whole number. Use 0 for metadata-only updates.

sat_per_vbyte.description: Fee rate in satoshis per virtual byte (e.g. 1, 5.5, 0.15). Check get_fee_estimate for current market rates.

transfer_destination.description: Transfer asset ownership to this address

name: compose_issuance
